Healthcare revenue

Denial management.

Work rejected revenue systematically and identify the process failures creating repeat denials.

Discuss this service View brief
Scope of work

What we work on.

Prioritise the queue

Denials are sorted by payer, reason, value and appeal deadline. Every claim receives an owner and a documented next step.

Prepare the response

The team assembles corrected claims or appeal letters and supporting evidence. Your clinicians sign off where clinical input is required.

Prevent repeat denials

Monthly reporting groups recurring causes by payer and code and tracks recovered balances. Findings feed into front-desk and coding checks.

Deliverables

What you receive.

  • Prioritised denial log with an owner and appeal deadline.
  • Corrected claims or appeal drafts with supporting records.
  • Recurring-cause analysis and specific feedback for practice teams.
Delivery partner

US healthcare operations.

Cloud Haven coordinates billing work with SuperBillOne LLC, a US-registered medical billing company in Austin, Texas. Your introductory call covers the practice workflow, payer mix and the responsibilities on each side.

Meet the billing partner
Questions

Before you start.

Can you take over older denied claims?

The first review checks each claim’s age against the relevant payer deadline. That determines which responses remain available.

What happens when clinical judgement is needed?

We prepare the paperwork. The provider reviews the clinical argument, particularly for medical necessity appeals.

How can we see which items are open?

A shared status log records each denial, and monthly reporting summarises open appeals, trends and recoveries.

Field notes

Further reading.

Common reasons for claim denials

A denial log is more useful when it shows where a problem began. Grouping payer responses lets a practice fix repeated mistakes at the right point in its workflow.

Preparing a claim appeal letter

Build the appeal around the payer’s specific reason for its decision. A clear case file helps the reviewer find the information the practice is relying on.
